clue.text: Hinder Solomon penning a book on scripture

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so the wise man's letters go round the rest

parts.note: Solomon is the proverbial wise man, a sage

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written on another sits above it, so the book comes before scripture

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, scripture

explanation.surface: A biblical tableau: wise King Solomon writing a book about scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penning' splits the wise man's word after its second letter to take the rest inside; in a down clue 'on' puts the book above scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: To sabotage a scheme is deliberately to obstruct or wreck it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Departed northwards with others

indicators.note: in a down clue going northwards means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the departed are the late, dead ones

explanation.surface: Someone left heading north with companions.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin abbreviation used in citations, meaning and other people.

clue.text: Azed addicts filling vacant bierkeller in fair

indicators.note: filling means going inside the remaining shell
vacant means emptied, leaving only the outside letters of the word

parts.note: Azed, the Observer setter's name, sounds like A to Z, so it gives AZ
AA, Alcoholics Anonymous, is a body of addicts

explanation.surface: Fans of the setter Azed drinking in a beer cellar at a fair.
explanation.walkthrough: Azed is the pseudonym of a famous Observer crossword setter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bazaar is a sale or market, as a church fair or fete is, a synonym.

clue.text: Confuse with wrong turns in performance in 24 across

parts.note: to fox someone is to baffle them

indicators.note: turns means the legal word for a wrong is read back to front

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Muddled dancers with wrong turns at a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: The foxtrot is a ballroom dance, performed at a ball (24 across).

clue.text: Determined a doubter will convert

indicators.note: converting changes the form, so the letters of a doubter are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sceptic will become a stubborn believer.
explanation.definitionFit: Obdurate means stubbornly resolute, unwilling to change course: a synonym.

clue.text: One smouldering vocalist who goes to the 24 across

parts.note: a cinder is a piece of coal still glowing
Ella Fitzgerald, the jazz singer

explanation.surface: A smoking singer who goes to the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: In the fairy tale, the heroine goes to the prince's ball (24 across) thanks to her fairy godmother.

clue.text: Feature extra large trousers

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
OS is outsize, a clothing size

explanation.surface: A clothing listing: outsize trousers with a feature.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinos are casual cotton twill trousers, an example of the garment.

clue.text: Old singer and players, one singing before 24 across

indicators.note: before means the earlier pieces come ahead of the final letter

parts.note: the cast is the set of actors in a play
an informer who sings to the police is a rat
a ball is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: An old singer with players and a vocalist before a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Castrati were male sopranos of the 17th and 18th centuries, an old type of singer.

clue.text: Reportedly be good on the 24 across

indicators.note: reportedly means what is spoken, so the words are heard

parts.note: to be good, correct, is to be right

explanation.surface: Supposedly behaving well at the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: On the ball is an idiom for alert and quick-witted, which a clever person is.

clue.text: Blackbird to launch a 24 across

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A blackbird taking off to catch something.
explanation.walkthrough: Blackbird looks like one word but splits into Black and bird.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bowler delivers the ball, so to deliver one is a verb sense.

clue.text: Staggering home, overwhelmed by gusto, and stumbling

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means engulfed, so the home word sits inside
stumbling means tottering about, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A drunk staggering home with gusto and stumbling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stumbling' gives ASTOUNDG, and 'overwhelmed by' says that jumble surrounds the word for home.
explanation.definitionFit: Staggering in the figurative sense is amazing, stunning, a synonym.

clue.text: Sheridan ceremoniously welcomes one at 24 across

indicators.note: welcomes means takes in, so the answer is held inside the words

explanation.surface: Playwright Sheridan formally greets a guest at a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: People dance at a ball, so a person dancing there is one present.

clue.text: See 22 across
She gives her address and, if not, a lock of hair

parts.note: or means otherwise, if not
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A woman giving her home address, or else a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A female public speaker delivers an address, a speech, punning on a home address.

clue.text: Rebuffed person with account about politician's makeovers

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the reversed word goes round the politician
rebuffed means pushed back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a saver keeps a bank account
MP is a Member of Parliament, the 's linking

explanation.surface: A rebuffed customer complaining about a politician's image makeovers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rebuffed' gives REVAS, and 'about' wraps that round the politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Revamps are renovations or overhauls, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: 24 across's movement training, eg workers and soldiers — potential unit

parts.note: PE is physical education, training
as means for example
worker ants
RE is the Royal Engineers
the volt is the unit of electric potential

explanation.surface: A training list: physical exercise for workers and soldiers as a unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 across here is John Ball, the priest who helped lead the uprising of 1381.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1381 uprising in England was the movement led by Wat Tyler and John Ball.

clue.text: They hang from the neck of special friend, married on the rebound

indicators.note: on the rebound means bouncing back, so the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: a pal is a friend
wed means married

explanation.surface: Things hanging from the neck of a special friend married on the rebound.
explanation.definitionFit: Dewlaps are the loose folds of skin dangling below the throat of cattle or people.

clue.text: For 100 pounds, design trumpet

parts.note: pro means in favour of
C is the Roman numeral 100
L is the abbreviation for pound, from libra
a design is an aim, intention

explanation.surface: A trumpet on sale for a hundred pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: To trumpet news is to announce it loudly, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Support rock band in dirty surroundings

indicators.note: in means placed within the surroundings

parts.note: a sty is a filthy enclosure

indicators.note: rock means shake about, so the letters of band are mixed

explanation.surface: Backing a rock band playing in a filthy venue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rock' is the anagram signal, not music; 'in' puts the jumble inside the pigsty.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand by someone is to back them, a phrasal verb synonym.

clue.text: He sells car, the Chinese model

parts.note: Merc is short for a Mercedes car
the Han are the main ethnic people of China
the Model T Ford

explanation.surface: A dealer selling a Chinese model car.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchant is a trader, someone who buys and sells goods.

clue.text: Sides of equilateral with smooth side

indicators.note: the sides of the word are its first and last letters

parts.note: even means level, smooth

explanation.surface: Geometry: a triangle's equal sides and a smooth side.
explanation.definitionFit: A football or cricket team has that many players, so the number stands for a team.

clue.text: With fortune in dollars, who changed job for 24 acrosses?

indicators.note: in means placed inside the jumbled letters
changed means the letters are altered in order

parts.note: chance is luck, fortune

explanation.surface: A man who changed job to make his fortune in dollars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' gives SHADOWLLOR and 'in' puts the fortune inside. Ed Balls (24 acrosses) held this post for the UK opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Ed Balls was Labour's opposition spokesman on the economy, so the role was his job.

clue.text: Lure of extremely statesmanlike fascist

indicators.note: extremely means the extreme letters, first and last

parts.note: Il Duce was Mussolini, the fascist leader

explanation.surface: The appeal of a fascist with statesmanlike manners.
explanation.definitionFit: To seduce is to entice or tempt, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Latitude taken by compilers of an erudite nature is justified

indicators.note: taken by means the latitude letter follows the compilers' pronoun

parts.note: setters refer to themselves as we
learned means erudite

explanation.surface: Scholarly setters taking liberties is justified.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deserved, merited by effort, is justified.

clue.text: Left backing return of Labour Party

indicators.note: backing means coming behind the other piece
return means the word comes back, read backwards

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party
L is left

explanation.surface: The Left supporting a Labour Party comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' looks like part of Labour Party, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A ball is a formal dancing party, a synonym.

clue.text: Top man on the 24 across

definitions.meaning: George ..., the Manchester United footballer, famous with a ball at his feet

explanation.surface: The top man on the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Best means finest, and George Best was the famed footballer on the ball.

clue.text: See 16
Defend media manipulation in 24 across's movement

parts.note: to back is to support, defend
spin is slanting news to the media

explanation.surface: Defending media manipulation in a ball game.
explanation.definitionFit: Backward rotation imparted to a ball in tennis or snooker is a movement of the ball.
